description: Map of the acrVA1 prophage and Cas12a identity comparison in M. bovoculi 58069
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrow
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
ft=requests.get(E+"efetch.fcgi",params={"db":"nuccore","id":"CP011374.1","rettype":"ft","retmode":"text"},timeout=200).text
recs=[];cur=None
for ln in ft.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith(">Feature") or not ln.strip(): continue
    p=ln.split("\t")
    if p[0] and re.match(r'^[<>]?\d+$',p[0]):
        s=int(p[0].lstrip("<>")); e=int(p[1].lstrip("<>")) if len(p)>1 and p[1] else s
        t=p[2] if len(p)>2 else ""
        if t: cur={"start":min(s,e),"end":max(s,e),"strand":"+" if s<=e else "-","type":t}; recs.append(cur)
    elif len(p)>=5 and p[3] and cur is not None: cur.setdefault(p[3],p[4])
df=pd.DataFrame(recs)
g=df[df.type=="gene"][["start","end","locus_tag"]].rename(columns={"locus_tag":"lt"})
cds=df[df.type=="CDS"].merge(g,on=["start","end"],how="left")
EL_S,EL_E=1616725,1672475
reg=cds[(cds.start>=1614000)&(cds.end<=1676000)].sort_values("start")

def cat(r):
    lt=r["lt"]; pr=str(r["product"])
    if lt=="AAX09_07405": return "acrVA1"
    if lt=="AAX09_07410": return "acrVA2"
    if "integrase" in pr: return "integrase"
    if "tail" in pr or "terminase" in pr: return "phage structural/packaging"
    if r.start<EL_S or r.end>EL_E: return "flanking chromosomal"
    return "prophage hypothetical"
reg["cat"]=reg.apply(cat,axis=1)
col={"acrVA1":"#E03131","acrVA2":"#F08C00","integrase":"#5F3DC4","phage structural/packaging":"#1971C2",
     "prophage hypothetical":"#ADB5BD","flanking chromosomal":"#2F9E44"}

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(14,7),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1.3,1]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.axvspan(EL_S/1e3,EL_E/1e3,color="#FFE3E3",alpha=0.7,zorder=0)
for _,r in reg.iterrows():
    y=0.25 if r.strand=="+" else -0.25
    ax.arrow(r.start/1e3,y,(r.end-r.start)/1e3*(1 if r.strand=="+" else 1),0,width=0.12,
             head_width=0.18,head_length=0.3,length_includes_head=True,
             color=col[r["cat"]],ec="none")
# tRNA-Val
ax.plot([1672399/1e3],[0],marker="v",color="black",ms=10)
ax.annotate("tRNA-Val\n(attR candidate)",(1672399/1e3,0.75),ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.annotate("acrVA1-acrVA2",(1624700/1e3,0.75),ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#E03131",weight="bold")
ax.annotate("integrase",(1671750/1e3,-0.85),ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#5F3DC4")
ax.annotate("terminase",(1652750/1e3,-0.85),ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#1971C2")
ax.annotate("tail genes",(1636000/1e3,-0.85),ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#1971C2")
# self-target protospacers
for pstart,lab,mmv in [(1629057,"protospacer, 0 mm, PAM TTTA",0),(1631222,"protospacer, 0 mm, PAM TTCG",0)]:
    ax.plot([pstart/1e3],[0.0],marker="*",ms=16,color="#C2255C")
ax.annotate("self-targeting protospacers\n(spacers 16 and 19 of the type V-A array)",
            (1630100/1e3,-1.2),ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#C2255C")
ax.set_ylim(-1.6,1.1); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("position on CP011374.1 (kb)")
ax.set_title("acrVA1 (AAX09_07405) lies inside a 55.8 kb tRNA-Val-associated prophage of Moraxella bovoculi 58069")
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
ax.legend(handles=[mpatches.Patch(color=v,label=k) for k,v in col.items()],fontsize=8,ncol=3,loc="upper left")

ax2=axes[1]
d=pd.DataFrame({"ortholog":["M. bovoculi Cas12a\n(same strain, AAX09_00210)","MbCas12a\n(PDB 6IV6)","M. caprae","M. lacunata","LbCas12a\n(reagent)","AsCas12a\n(reagent)"],
                "pct":[100.0,95.4,95.0,92.4,40.0,32.2]})
bars=ax2.bar(d.ortholog,d.pct,color=["#E03131","#1971C2","#1971C2","#1971C2","#868E96","#868E96"])
for b,v in zip(bars,d.pct): ax2.text(b.get_x()+b.get_width()/2,v+1.5,f"{v:.1f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax2.set_ylabel("% amino-acid identity"); ax2.set_ylim(0,112)
ax2.set_title("Identity to the Cas12a encoded by the acrVA1 host strain (global BLOSUM62 Needleman-Wunsch)")
ax2.tick_params(axis="x",labelsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

reg[["lt","start","end","strand","product","cat"]].to_csv("acrVA1_prophage_map.csv",index=False)
print(reg[["lt","start","end","strand","product","cat"]].head(3).to_string())
